ctx.x: East Side as one of the I guess biggest personalities in that particular field of that kind of entertainment. Anyway, Beverly came with us, and he remained with us until Joe was well enough to come back.

Somehow, the accident didn't seem to change Joe's driving habits at all. Because coming out of the hospital, it seems as if he was in Washington D.C. here, and within a matter of weeks or months that he'd been back to work, he was driving down Florida Avenue here... I wasn't there, but someone told that he had hit five cars on his way... And this is right in the city.
